title: Mendocino College Ceramics Courses (Studio Arts / Ceramics Degree or Certificate)
source_quote: The ceramic studio incorporates 18 wheels, 5 electric and 4 gas reduction kilns, 1 raku and saggar, and a soda kiln with a dedicated teaching team.
evidence_sentence: The ceramics department page lists its equipment including a soda kiln with a dedicated teaching team.
evidence_quote: a soda kiln with a dedicated teaching team
summary: Mendocino College's ceramics program uses soda, gas reduction, raku, and pit/barrel/saggar kilns. Enroll in any ceramics course or pursue the AA in Ceramics or Master Technician Certificate to access these firings.
